comparisonScope: Same concurrency20 benchmark: before and after shared admission SQL round-trip optimization. Both runs precede paid-funding filter and post-COMMIT admission timing. This comparison is separate from the final operational performance artifact.
mechanism: Immutable quote pre-read before queue; provider-first lock dependency and owner lock in one lock-only statement; redundant video-global lock removed; capacity/quote-use/runtime reads combined in a separate post-lock statement. Account, lots, storage, asset locks and immutable ledger remain.
limitations: Local deterministic Node harness, synthetic MP4, external HTTP/storage mocks and 10ms provider delay. Not Cloudflare throughput or real video latency.
requestToReservationWriteMs uses the historical in-transaction write marker, not full COMMIT acknowledgement. Final operational artifact uses the corrected commit-observed marker.
Before lock wait starts at admissionTransactionStartedAt, which was immediately before the lock call; after uses explicit providerCapacityLockRequestedAt.
No real paid calls, model time, moderation cost or browser first frame were measured.
Concurrency20 is a test-only limit; production configuration remains maximum5.
After P95 1132ms remains above the one-second goal; no assertion of target attainment.
